findings.F1: In choppy markets, a coin's 30-day return predicts its next 7 days, but only on the falling side. On the offset-0 7-day grid of folds B, C, the slope of excess return on a negative 30-day return is 0.38 (t 3.93, 111 cases). The slope on a positive 30-day return is -0.07 (t -0.81, 104 cases). This explains why the tested long-only idea was inconclusive (slope t 0.86).
findings.F2: In choppy markets, after a negative 30-day return the coin falls 5.1 % below its normal 7-day drift on average. The t is -2.53 with the cases of one day summed, over 111 cases on 54 days. Every one of the 12 coins with cases shows a negative mean, from -1.3 % (BTC) to -10.6 % (AAVE, DOGE). Every year is negative too, from -3.1 % (2019) to -7.7 % (2021).
findings.F3: The graded effect holds at the ends of the choppy 30-day quintiles. The weakest-month fifth is followed by -9.4 % excess over 7 days (t -4.95, 43 cases) and the second fifth by -4.4 % (t -2.46). The three upper fifths sit between +0.5 % and +2.3 % (all t under 1.3).
findings.F4: The negative-side slope keeps its sign on all 7 grid offsets: t 3.93, 1.13, 0.80, 1.04, 3.36, 2.65 and 2.20, on 97 to 122 cases each. Four of the seven offsets pass t 2. It also survives leaving out 2018: slope 0.41, t 3.97, 95 cases.
findings.F5: In choppy markets the continuation lives in the calmer half of each coin's 30-day swing. There the full slope is 0.26 (t 3.86, 160 cases) and the negative-side slope 0.50 (t 2.64, 71 cases). In the more agitated half they are 0.007 (t 0.12, 55 cases) and 0.24 (t 1.56, 40 cases).
findings.F6: Scaling the 30-day return by the coin's 30-day daily swing (times √30) strengthens the choppy-market slope to t 4.84 on 215 cases, against t 3.81 for the raw 30-day return.
findings.F7: Outside choppy markets the sign reverses: a negative 30-day return is followed by a rebound (slope -0.13, t -2.91, 471 cases). This is the falling-market rebound that the profile map already holds 16 times in falling agitated long, so it is not proposed.
findings.F8: The other angles showed nothing that stands out after this many looks. The past 7-day return in chop gave a largest quintile t of -1.90. The next 3 days after 1-day moves of 2 or more of their usual size gave t from 0.13 to 1.81. The coin volatility terciles were only significant in the chop high-vol tercile (t -3.05, 46 cases), which F5 already covers.

ideas.idea: In a choppy market, the larger a coin's fall over the past 30 days, the more it keeps falling over the next 7 days.
ideas.consequence: After a weak month in a trendless market, a trader takes a short sized by the month's fall, or refuses a long bought as a range bounce.
ideas.name: choppy month fall continues

ideas.idea: In a choppy, calm market, the larger a coin's 30-day fall measured against its own daily swing over those 30 days, the more it keeps falling over the next 7 days.
ideas.consequence: In a quiet, trendless coin, a month's fall that is large for its swing is a reason to be short for the following week.
ideas.name: calm chop scaled fall continues
